name: pir-stream
refuses: element header not 16B-clean, node/root count inconsistent with body, cell opcode outside the packed-IR vocabulary
doc: packed-IR element sequence: [u32 magic PIR0][u16 ver][u16 flags][u32 nroots][u32 nnodes] + node cells, self-describing per element (ADR-0005).  ir_read frames each element's span; ir_depack builds the arena representation.
